subject.title: refactor(infra): move exec approvals into the shared SQLite state DB

question: Should this PR’s intentional fail-closed upgrade gate be accepted as the required behavior for users who still have a legacy exec-approvals file, once the migration proof is supplied?
rationale: The code changes the persistence and recovery behavior of command-authorization state; deciding whether an upgrade may temporarily block execution until Doctor runs is a security and operator-experience choice.

options.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
options.body: Keep the canonical SQLite-only runtime and require a one-time Doctor migration, with proof for both fresh and upgraded installations.

options.title: Preserve a transitional runtime path
options.body: Retain a bounded compatibility mechanism for legacy files, accepting added complexity and a longer file-era security boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical SQLite-only runtime and require a one-time Doctor migration, with proof for both fresh and upgraded installations.
